thread:
noah: hey all, new joiner here. first Buildkite run on my onboarding branch fails during checkout with a 403. error shows 'remote: Repository not found' even though I can open the repo in the browser. anyone know the quick fix?

lina: welcome! :wave: most likely the GitHub App used by Buildkite doesn't have access to that repo. is this repo under a team org or a fork?

noah: it's the main org repo (private). I suspect app permissions since CI clones via the app token. logs: 
```
Cloning into 'repo'...
fatal: unable to access 'https://github.com/redwood-inc/core.git/': The requested URL returned error: 403
2026-03-23T13:02:11Z agent: git clone https://x-access-token@github.com/redwood-inc/core.git -> exit status 128
```

zane: if you don't have org admin, easiest is to create a short-lived PAT with repo scope and set BK_GIT_TOKEN in pipeline env to unblock. longer term we prefer GH App.

lina: also check the GitHub App install settings: sometimes it's installed only on selected repos. emily or ops can add the repo.

noah: who should I ping to get it added?

zane: ping @ops-bot or open an infra-access ticket, but ops-bot will notify the oncall.

ops-bot: infra-access request created: #IA-1024 for adding redwood-inc/core to redwood-ci GH App (requested by noah). ETA: 2h.

noah: thanks, I'll try the temporary PAT in the meantime. one more sanity check: if I use GH Actions instead of Buildkite would it be the same permission issue?

lina: yes, similar root cause — runner or app needs repo access. for GH Actions, the token is usually GITHUB_TOKEN or a PAT with correct scopes.

ci-bot: Buildkite: job #205 started by noah (onboarding/noah)  checkout failed earlier (403)

ops-bot: infra note: updated GH App install to include redwood-inc/core. refreshed app tokens. please re-run the job to verify.

noah: re-run now...

ci-bot: Buildkite: job #205 re-run by noah  running

noah: looks good now, checkout completed and tests started. thanks for the help!

lina: welcome aboard again :tada: we'll add a short checklist to the eng-infra onboarding doc for this exact flow (GH App vs PAT, where to ask).
